blocks.source: Vol IV, The Physical Body, § Historical Perspective and Further Reading
blocks.md: The freshness budget rests on foundations established well before the advent of digital control. @nyquist1928certain quantified the transmission capacity of telegraph channels relative to available bandwidth. @shannon1949communication formalized the sampling theorem in the form used throughout this chapter: a continuous signal band-limited below half the sampling frequency is completely determined by discrete samples, whereas unattenuated higher-frequency dynamics fold back into the passband as aliasing distortion. Clock synchronization subsequently migrated from software operating systems directly into physical networking silicon.

questions.q: The section **Historical Perspective and Further Reading** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Before torque reaches a winding the permission path must find non-negative margin in all five physical budgets at once (observation age, stopping distance, deliverable torque, winding temperature, supply), because one budget's slack never pays another's deficit.
The deceleration a stop may assume is the minimum of the brake's capability, the traction limit mu*g, and the drive's torque limit, each owned and evidenced separately.

A physical limit governs an admission decision only as a six-element record (value, conditions, uncertainty, margin, runtime detector, provenance with evidence category), and uncertainty about the measurement is distinct from margin held in reserve.

A reduction N multiplies torque by N but reflects rotor inertia by N^2, so acceleration peaks at the inertia-matching ratio and, for a fixed motor and gear, holding heat times reflected inertia does not depend on N.
